info.title: suno-api
info.description: Use API to call the music generation service of Suno.ai and easily integrate it into agents like GPTs.

post.summary: Generate audio via Suno v2-web style payload.
post.description: Single generation endpoint for simple music, custom songs, sounds, and cover/remix. Pass `task: "sound"` for Sounds mode, or `task: "cover"` with `cover_clip_id` for cover/remix. If `tags` or `title` is present, the request is treated as custom mode.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously. The lyrics depict the sorrow of people after the war.

mv.description: Suno model name alias used by the web payload.

wait_audio.description: Whether to wait for music generation, default is false, directly return audio task information; set to true, will wait for up to 100s until the audio is generated.

task.description: Optional Suno task, such as sound or cover.

generation_type.description: Suno generation type. Cover defaults to SIMPLE_REMIX.

tags.description: Custom mode tags or sound description.

user_uploaded_images_b64.description: Base64 image payloads passed through to Suno.

cover_start_s.description: Cover source start time in seconds.

cover_end_s.description: Cover source end time in seconds.

override_fields.description: Suno override fields. Cover defaults to ["prompt"].

persona_id.description: Persona ID passed through to Suno.

artist_clip_id.description: Artist clip ID passed through to Suno.

artist_start_s.description: Artist source start time in seconds.

artist_end_s.description: Artist source end time in seconds.

continue_clip_id.description: Continue clip ID passed through to Suno.

transaction_uuid.description: Optional transaction UUID. A UUID is generated when omitted.

token_provider.description: Captcha token provider value passed through to Suno.

post.summary: Generate audio based on Prompt - OpenAI API format compatibility.
post.description:
Convert the `/api/generate` API to be compatible with the OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` API format. 

Generally used in OpenAI compatible clients.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously. The lyrics depict the sorrow of people after the war.

data.description: Text description for music, with details like title, album cover, lyrics, and more.

post.description: Create a Suno audio upload and return a pre-signed S3 POST target. Upload the audio file to the returned `url` with all returned `fields` as multipart form fields, then call `/api/uploads/audio/{id}/upload-finish`.
Notify Suno that the audio file has been uploaded to the S3 target returned by `/api/uploads/audio`.

get.description: Get the current Suno audio upload processing status. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.

audio_id.description: The ID of the audio clip to extend.

prompt.description: Detailed prompt, including information such as music lyrics.
prompt.example:
[lrc]Silent battlegrounds, no birds' song
Shadows of war, where we don't belong
May flowers of peace bloom in this place
Let's guard this precious dream with grace
[endlrc]

continue_at.description: Extend a new clip from a song at mm:ss(e.g. 00:30). Default extends from the end of the song.

post.summary: Make stem tracks (separate audio and music track).
post.description: Make stem tracks (separate audio and music track).

audio_id.description: The ID of the song to generate stems for.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Audio IDs, separated by commas. Leave blank to return a list of all music.

get.description: Returns the locally cached Suno model list and the time it was last updated from the server.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last model list update, empty string if never fetched.

external_key.description: External key used when generating audio

is_default_free_model.description: Whether this is the default free model

is_default_model.description: Whether this is the default model

can_use.description: Whether the current account can use this model

post.description: Triggers an immediate fetch of the latest model list from Suno and saves it to the local cache. Use `?action=refresh` as a query parameter.

credits_left.description: Remaining credits,Each generated audio consumes 5 credits.

get.summary: Get clip information based on ID.
get.description: Retrieve specific clip information using the provided clip ID as a query parameter.

post.summary: Generate the whole song from extensions.
post.description: Concatenate audio clips to generate a complete song using the provided clip ID.

get.description: Retrieve persona information, including associated clips and pagination data.

is_suno_persona.description: Whether this is a Suno official persona

is_following.description: Whether the current user is following this persona

post.description: Initialize a Suno clip from an uploaded audio file. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.
Set metadata for a Suno clip. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.

prompts.description: Prompt suggestions for simple music generation.
example: mellow folk metal song about the tree outside my window
whimsical dub song about one-sided love
Time moves slow when you're waiting for a sign
I keep your memory like a song I can't forget

is_pending_personalization.description: Whether Suno is still preparing personalized suggestions.

post.description: Accept or set the generated audio description for a Suno clip. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.

get.description: Get waveform aggregates for a Suno clip. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.
Get prompt suggestions from Suno. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.

prompts.description: Prompt suggestions for simple music generation.
example: mellow folk metal song about the tree outside my window
whimsical dub song about one-sided love
Time moves slow when you're waiting for a sign
I keep your memory like a song I can't forget

is_pending_personalization.description: Whether Suno is still preparing personalized suggestions.

post.description: Upsample user-provided style tags into a richer Suno prompt tag description.

original_tags.description: Original style tags to expand. Use an empty string when no tags are provided.

is_instrumental.description: Whether the target song is instrumental.

upsampled.example: cabaret jazz, tango spoken word, orchestral ballad, 92 BPM

get.summary: Get clip information by path ID.
get.description: Retrieve clip information by path parameter. The response is returned exactly as Suno provides it.

post.summary: Generate Audio - Custom Mode compatibility endpoint
post.description: Backward-compatible Custom Mode endpoint. New integrations can use `/api/generate` with `tags` and `title`; this route is kept for existing callers.

wait_audio.description: Whether to wait for music generation.

suno_generate_metadata.description: Optional Suno web generation metadata. Only fields provided by the client will be sent to Suno.

is_max_mode.description: Whether to enable Suno max mode.

is_remix.description: Whether the request is a remix or cover flow.

video_url.description: Music video download link, can be used to share

status.description: The generated states include submitted, queue, streaming, complete.

gpt_description_prompt.description: Simple mode on user input prompt, Suno will generate formal prompts, lyrics, etc.

prompt.description: The final prompt for executing the generation task, customized by the user in custom mode, automatically generated by Suno in simple mode.

tags.description: Music genre. User-provided in custom mode, automatically generated by Suno in simple mode.

fields.description: Multipart form fields required by the S3 POST upload.

is_file_uploaded.description: Whether Suno already considers the file uploaded.

copyright_muted.description: Whether the uploaded audio is copyright muted.

error_message.example: This audio matches an existing recording in our catalog.
